events.event_name: CHANEL COCO MADEMOISELLE CRUSH ABSOLU Event
events.what_it_is: A café-inspired CHANEL fragrance experience for COCO MADEMOISELLE CRUSH ABSOLU with personalized fragrance discovery, the broader COCO MADEMOISELLE line, hair/body products, makeup and photo moments.
events.what_is_free: Admission and the fragrance-discovery experience are free. CHANEL's official event page says appointments are limited but walk-ins are encouraged; product purchases are optional.
events.caveats: CHANEL's official page confirms the dates, address, hours and that walk-ins are encouraged. Appointments are recommended/limited but are not required for public access. Normal capacity may still apply.
events.practical_notes: Open September 13 from 10 AM–7 PM, then again September 18 from noon–7 PM and September 19–20 from 10 AM–7 PM. Walk-ins are encouraged; appointments are optional.

events.address: Jack & Charlie's No. 118, 118 Greenwich Ave, New York, NY 10011
events.what_it_is: A one-day Maison Perrier NYFW atelier offering on-site custom hat-and-scarf combinations hand-crafted by a resident seamstress.
events.what_is_free: Current event listings describe the activation as open to the public and advertise free on-site custom hat-and-scarf combinations.
events.caveats: The event itself is currently documented by a secondary NYC events source rather than a standalone Maison Perrier event page. Jack & Charlie's official site independently confirms the venue address. No RSVP or approval requirement is published in the event listing.
events.practical_notes: Sunday, September 13 from 11 AM–5 PM at Jack & Charlie's No. 118. Treat promotional items as subject to on-site availability.
